test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There are eight persons, i.e. A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a rectangular table. Four of the eight are sitting on four corners of the table facing opposite to the center while those who are sitting on the sides are facing the center. B is sitting at one of the corners. There are two people between A and B. G is sitting on one of the corners with E as his left neighbour. D is sitting second to the right of A. C and F are neighbours of A. There are two persons between H and C to the right of H. Who is sitting at the second place to the right of B?
solution:
Let's analyze the given information step by step to determine the seating arrangement around the rectangular table.

1. B is sitting at one of the corners facing opposite to the center.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93c4fece72902d646c777559754f9c34acd818529a18fcb77a1648272802a1e5.png] 

2. There are two people between A and B. So there are two possibilities. 

**Case I: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/636e4caf815e20bd8627d05f40f2faa54671eb0f1940a2ddfa41d59f712658a7.png] 

**Case II: ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae4efafabe50acbaac2789605cb5b354a0d2e916021ed924ecfc11a221c35d82.png] 

 

3. D is sitting second to the right of A. C and F are neighbors of A.

**Case I**: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e015f8960aa1efac5c37fe38584173db917993c9295935d484bde56f7611127.png] 

**Case II:** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517c9e05c99e97c2f3d097183604156f1072ab50741e19ea8c4827d9e5edfe44.png] 

4. G is sitting on one of the corners with E as his left neighbor. so, option I is eliminated. 

Case II: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab1bb195810857ffc4f95bbf377742ada9a4d8267633c214edc476c99a683691.png] 

 

5. There are two persons between H and C to the right of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5541abfc35529211d061e705cbf8baa8a9c767211d15cda9efdb67f3d55ed84e.png] 

Therefore, second place of B is F. 

Hence, the correct answer is :** Option 3. **
